pages.title: Special Delivery
pages.text: Develop your chosen fighting style and prepare for the next encounter.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Load the proper ammunition and fire in a safe location. Your actual projectile hit counts; clicking a machine does not.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Catapult movement aims, right-click previews trajectory and Space loads/fires; use stones, clusters and fire/explosive pots under native recipes.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Ballista uses right-click precision aiming and a direct ballistic bolt, unlike the catapult arc.
